results.original_name: Margarita: Que tu cuento valga la pena
results.overview: Margarita tells the story of an orphaned teenager with a life like a movie, with many doubts and almost no certainty about her story, who, following her wish, will arrive at a very magical place where she can live and fulfill her dreams, without knowing that this house was the place where she was born and that the perfidious Delfina usurped it to build her empire.
results.name: Margarita: Make Your Story Count
